This common MMHE is comprised of a broad portfolio for which SE&V is responsible for managing, totaling tens of thousands of individual National Stock Numbers (NSNs), each tied to specific aircraft worldwide mission requirements. 1.2 Scope The purpose of the Next Generation Ammunition & Munition Equipment (NGAME) is to provide modern and reliable MMHE. This contract establishes a flexible and responsive framework to support the full life cycle of MMHE used in ammunition and munition operations. The Branch seeks to establish a streamlined contracting structure to meet the end mission of transporting, loading/lifting armaments and buildup of munitions highlighted in the Statement of Objectives (SOO).
